title: Beyond Accuracy: A Dual-Judge Evaluation Protocol for Vision-Language Models in Legally Grounded Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2608.24258v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI systems are increasingly evaluated for legally accountable settings, where correct outputs must also be justifiable against an applicable legal standard. Existing legal-AI benchmarks and LLM-as-judge protocols provide important infrastructure for measuring task performance and open-ended response quality. We contribute one additional evaluation signal: a dual-judge protocol that pairs a standard 0-10 quality judge with a strict binary semantic-equivalence judge against a human-curated reference.   We study a controlled, visually grounded regulatory task - UK traffic-sign interpretation, whose meaning is a codified question with a known reference for every input - and measure not merely whether the two judges disagree (by construction they must) but how much and where. translated_title: 超越准确性：面向法律依据任务中视觉语言模型的双重评审协议
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24258v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人工智能系统越来越多地被用于法律问责场景中评估，其中正确的输出还必须能够依据适用的法律标准进行合理性论证。现有的法律AI基准和基于大语言模型的评审协议为衡量任务性能和开放式回答质量提供了重要基础设施。我们贡献了一个额外的评估信号：一种双重评审协议，将标准的0-10分质量评审与针对人工策划参考的严格二元语义等价评审配对。我们研究了一个受控的、视觉基础的监管任务——英国交通标志解读，其含义是一个编码问题，每个输入都有已知参考——并测量不仅仅是两个评审是否分歧（它们必然分歧），而是分歧的程度和位置。在七种可见度水平和两种遮挡模式下的4,680次评估中，两个评审中度相关（点二列相关系数 r = 0.644），同时揭示了一个不对称性。
tldr: 提出一种双重评审协议，通过结合质量评分和严格语义等价判断，揭示了在视觉语言模型处理法律依据任务中评估指标之间的不对称性。
en_tdlr: Proposes a dual-judge protocol combining quality scoring with strict semantic equivalence to reveal asymmetry between evaluation metrics for vision-language models in legally grounded tasks.
